records.curation_notice: Compare metal/host surface and stray reflections; approximate era is historical, not a direct photo of a 1962 Mass.

records.creator: Pierre Poschadel

records.curation_notice: Historical ornate specimen; reviewer may reclassify as supplementary/historical. High-res source not equivalent to historically ordinary 1962 Sunday liturgy.

records.creator: Renhour48
records.source_description: Catholic cathedral gilt-silver covered ciborium registered as protected French historic movable object PM35000169. Distinct from the cathedral paten.
records.curation_notice: Confirm in full image the lid-and-cross silhouette is legible and complete; not evidence of 1962 use at that cathedral.

records.creator: Jean-Pol GRANDMONT
records.venue: Musée des Beaux-Arts, Arras, France; from church of Villers-Brûlin
records.source_description: Covered nineteenth-century Catholic ciborium manufactured by Favier of Paris in 1871, formerly in Villers-Brûlin parish. Museum provenance and object identity supplied by original Commons record.
records.curation_notice: Commons offers GFDL or CC BY; record CC BY 4.0 selection. Its separate (2) image is the same exact vessel: do not count as different candidate.

records.creator: Christophe Evellin
records.venue: Atelier Jean-Louis Evellin provenance; original photo by Christophe Evellin
records.source_description: Clearly identified Eucharistic ciborium of solid silver cup and cover, silvered metal stem/base and ivory knop. Source file carries 1962 in its name; do not equate year with photo of an actual 1962 liturgy.
records.curation_notice: Ivory knop is historical object material; check object composition and any special legal considerations before packaging derivatives. Year 1962 does NOT authorise claims about its ceremonial use.

source_rights_review: Source pages, photograph creator, license, dimensions and subject descriptions individually checked on Wikimedia Commons. Original file permissions are not publication approval or aesthetic/representative judgement.
curation_policy: Patens and covered ciboria are different Roman Catholic vessels. Different historical specimens count as comparative object photographs only when clearly distinguished; museum artefacts never substantiate exact 1962 Mass use. Other-church objects and misleading filenames excluded.
